messages:
marta_csm: Flagging BlueHarbor QBR prep 0m pre-read needed. Main ask: embeddings-heavy traffic coming from webhook fanout; need a quick runway + throttle plan. Can we do a 20m sync at 3:30pm PT today? cc @owen_eng @talia_fin

owen_eng: I can make 3:30. Quick summary: their webhook fanout multiplies incoming events -> multiple embedding calls per user event (some duplicates). Also retries are set to aggressive backoff which amplifies spikes.

talia_fin: Billing alert: invoice B-9911 flagged last night. Current run-rate ~$3.9k/mo; embeddings ~77% of spend. If webhook load increases 1.4x -> ~$5.5k/mo; if unbounded fanout x2.5 -> ~$9.8k/mo. Need short list of cost levers for QBR pre-read.

ravi_support: From enablement: the customer uses per-event embedding without dedupe or aggregation. They also call embeddings synchronously in the webhook path, causing retries when downstream is slow. I can demo a debounce + aggregation pattern in the sync.

infra-bot: Alert: BlueHarbor embed_fanout_alert triggered (rule: webhook_embed_fanout). Spike +120% v baseline yesterday. Details: https://redwood.ops/alerts/BB-9911

marta_csm: Proposed agenda for 20m: 1) baseline + two scenarios (x1.4, x2.5) 2) immediate mitigations (debounce/aggregate, server-side prefix cache, per-endpoint soft quotas, sampling) 3) commit vs on-demand options + owners. OK?

owen_eng: I'll bring per-route token CSV and a small forecast script: `python tools/forecast.py --acct blueharbor --days 90`

talia_fin: I'll prepare a compact commit vs on-demand table (3mo vs 6mo) and quick numbers for a small burst reserve. Expect a 7-10% savings on a 3mo small commit at current run-rate.

ravi_support: Quick enablement snippet (pseudo):
```
# debounce + aggregate in webhook handler
buffer[event.key].append(payload)
if buffer[event.key].age > 5s or buffer[event.key].size >= 10:
  batched = aggregate(buffer[event.key])
  embeddings.embed_batch(batched)
  buffer[event.key].clear()
```
Also: move embedding calls off the sync path and return 202 to the webhook sender.

owen_eng: Another low-friction change: server-side prefix KV cache to avoid re-embedding repeated user prompts. Snippet (py):
```
if prefix in kv_cache:
  return kv_cache[prefix]
v = embeddings.embed(prefix)
kv_cache[prefix] = v
return v
```
Will demo both in the sync.

talia_fin: Quick forecast (rough):
- current run-rate: $3.9k/mo
- scenario x1.4 -> $5.5k/mo
- scenario x2.5 -> $9.8k/mo
Assumes avg 1.8 vectors/request @384-d. I'll post a tidy table before the call.

marta_csm: Mitigation playbook we'll propose in the pre-read: 1) debounce + server-side aggregation 2) prefix cache + memoize common inputs 3) per-endpoint soft quotas with 85% alerting and automatic slow-down 4) short commit (3mo) + small burst reserve for nightly batches. Assign owners and ETA?

owen_eng: I'll own the debounce/aggregation rollout and the demo. ETA: patch + demo code by EOD.

ravi_support: I'll own enablement docs and the webhook patch checklist; will send a sample PR for their SDK.

talia_fin: I'll own the commit math + reserve proposal and publish to /shared/finance/blueharbor-cost-options. ETA EOD.

marta_csm: Locking 3:30pm. I'll send the invite and attach the pre-read: forecast table + playbook. If you can't attend drop notes here. :white_check_mark: End.
